skill_name: Deduce the scientific principles underlying the sport of pole vaulting
workflow: Pole vaulting is based on the scientific principles of force, velocity, mass and momentum. When a person swings the pole, centripetal force is generated, allowing the vaulter to move in a circular motion without having to be in contact with the pole. As the vaulter moves in a circular motion, potential energy is stored in the pole, which is then converted to kinetic energy.
